newsitem.title: MEXICO: Spain's Repsol wins Mexico Toluca natgas tender.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Repsol wins Mexico Toluca natgas tender.

text.p: Spain's Repsol through its Mexican unit, was declared the winner of a concession to distribute natural gas in the industrial city of Toluca, Mexico's Energy Regulatory Commission (CRE) said in a public ceremony on Thursday.
Repsol offered consumers $0.47 per gigacalorie, and pledged to service a minimum residential client base of 47,279 in the first five years of the concession.
This is the fourth and largest of a series of concessions Mexico has sold to distribute natural gas.
Analysts say an estimated $100 million is expected in investment to develop regional infrastructures and build a new pipeline. ((--Timna Tanners, Mexico City newsroom +525 728 7902))
